info.title: Federal marketing rules and penalty amounts for law firms: FTC, FCC, CAN-SPAM and TCPA: data API
info.summary: Static, read-only JSON and CSV files. No key, no sign-up. CORS open.
info.description:
Federal marketing rules and penalty amounts for law firms: FTC, FCC, CAN-SPAM and TCPA: The federal amounts and duties a law firm's ads, reviews, endorsements, calls, texts and emails run into: the FTC's civil penalty amounts, its rule on consumer reviews and testimonials, its Endorsement Guides, the Telemarketing Sales Rule, the CAN-SPAM Act and rule, the FCC's TCPA rules and forfeiture amounts, and the TCPA itself. One row per amount or duty, with the section, our plain-English summary, the verbatim text it rests on, the date of the section's current version and the date we read it.

Probative Growth is a marketing firm, not a law firm; not legal advice. Every JSON response starts with a "meta" object holding the credit line, citation, DOI and license (CC BY 4.0).
